notes_zh:
- **修复** OCR 识别逐行排版的图片（梗图、诗歌、清单等）时换行丢失、整段文字粘连的问题（macOS 26 的 Markdown OCR 路径）
- **优化** 「OCR 转 Markdown」开关不再要求先开启图片 OCR，它同样作用于「粘贴 OCR 文字」
- **优化** 图片条目的「重新识别」在图片 OCR 关闭时也可用，便于刷新旧的识别结果
- **优化** 设置分区标题「图片 OCR」更名为「OCR」
notes_en:
- **Fix** OCR losing line breaks on line-structured images (memes, poems, lists) — text came out glued into one string on the macOS 26 Markdown OCR path
- **Improve** The "OCR to Markdown" toggle no longer requires background image OCR to be enabled — it also governs "Paste OCR Text"
- **Improve** "Recognize again" is now available for image clips even with image OCR off, so stale OCR results can be refreshed
- **Improve** Settings section title renamed from "Image OCR" to "OCR"

beta.notes_zh:
- **新增** 快捷面板适配 macOS 26 的 Liquid Glass（液态玻璃）外观；可在 设置 → 外观 → 快捷面板背景 中选择「液态玻璃」或「不透明」
- **新增** App 图标适配 macOS 26：分层液态玻璃图标，深色模式自动适配（旧系统保持原图标）
- **优化** 设置窗口全新布局：原生悬浮侧边栏（macOS 26 上呈现玻璃质感），窗口支持调整大小并记住位置
- **优化** 设置分类重组：「偏好」更名为「快捷面板」；「链接预览」与「OCR」合并为「预览与识别」；「语言」与「剪贴板监听」移至「通用」
- **修复** 繁体中文、日语、韩语、俄语等语言中 100+ 条未翻译的界面文案
beta.notes_en:
- **New** Quick Panel adopts the macOS 26 Liquid Glass look; choose between "Liquid Glass" and "Opaque" backgrounds in Settings → Appearance
- **New** App icon updated for macOS 26: layered Liquid Glass icon with automatic dark mode variant (older systems keep the original icon)
- **Improve** Redesigned Settings window: native floating sidebar (glass on macOS 26), resizable window that remembers its position
- **Improve** Settings reorganized: "Preferences" renamed to "Quick Paste"; "Link Preview" and "OCR" merged into "Preview & Recognition"; language and clipboard monitoring moved to "General"
- **Fix** 100+ untranslated UI strings in Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, and Russian
